units.text: The President can remove the UPSC Chairman with the advice of an inquiry committee headed by the Chief Justice of India.

units.text: The Chairman can be removed if he is adjudged insolvent.

units.subject_rule: Polity: grounds for removal of UPSC Chairman (Art. 317)

units.text: The Chairman can be removed if he engages in paid employment during his term.
units.subject_rule: Polity: grounds for removal of UPSC Chairman (Art. 317)

units.text: The UPSC Chairman can be removed if proven guilty in any civil case.
units.true_fact: A civil case is not a ground; grounds are insolvency, paid employment, infirmity, proved misbehaviour.
units.subject_rule: Polity: grounds for removal of UPSC Chairman (Art. 317)

solve.steps: Reject 5 (civil case not a ground) - kills (c); 2 and 4 are sure grounds; the option containing 1,2,3,4 is the widest remaining.
solve.min_knowledge: Art. 317 grounds; civil case not one.

doubt: Key follows the paper; strictly misbehaviour is inquired into by the Supreme Court (not a CJI-headed committee) and the President's opinion covers only infirmity, not misconduct, so 1 and 3 are loose.
